problem_ja: 注記を Notes と呼び、他の説明が使う「comment box」と語が違う。
suggested_en: Comment boxes on the chart. Each one points at a task, a highlight box or a free point.

problem_ja: 「Rectangles」と言い、他の説明が使う「highlight box」の語を使っていない。
suggested_en: Highlight boxes: rectangles on the chart that mark a range of days over a range of task groups, drawn with a frame, a fill or both.

problem_ja: キーを毎回書く理由（製品の既定値が後で変わっても絵を変えないため）は設計の理由で、プロパティの中身ではない。
suggested_en: How the document is drawn when it is opened. Keys that always have a value are always written.

problem_ja: 72語・5文で長い。ヘッダー等に効かない点と文書が開く値の点を詰められる。
suggested_en: Display scale of the schedule drawing, in percent: at 100 every ...Px value is drawn as that many CSS pixels, at 50 at half size. It scales shapes and text together; it does not change the app header, the command palette or the browser zoom.

problem_ja: 「before the tool's own ratios」が内部の言い回しで、Haiku も何を指すか分からなかった。
suggested_en: Text size step of the schedule: small, medium or large, which are 7.5, 8.75 and 10 CSS pixels at displayScalePercent 100. The document opens at this step; a reader who changes it edits the document.

problem_ja: 「never below 1」は範囲の言い直し、最後の文は別プロパティの案内で、4文45語と長い。
suggested_en: Vertical size of the task figures, as a ratio to the default size. 1 is the default size; 2 draws plan bars, actual bars and task name labels twice as tall.

problem_ja: 54語・多文で長く、深さの数え方が一読で追いにくい（Haiku も複雑と指摘）。
suggested_en: How deep task groups with treeState auto open. A top-level task group is depth 1. With value N, task groups down to depth N are open, so rows down to depth N + 1 are shown; 0 shows only the top-level task groups, closed.

problem_ja: 子の説明（D032-D034）を言い直し、4文になっている。「Fit」だけで D022 の「Fit to screen」と語も揃わない。
suggested_en: The span of days, firstDay to lastDay (both included), that Fit to screen and picture export show instead of the whole schedule when isFixed is true. Absent means no fit span.

problem_ja: 「the shown clock」は内部の言い回しで、Haiku も言い回しの硬さを指摘した。
suggested_en: The first day of the fit span (included), in the time zone the chart is shown in (viewTimeZone).

problem_ja: 「Fit」だけで、D022 などの「Fit to screen」と語が揃わない。
suggested_en: When true, Fit to screen and picture export show the fit span instead of the whole schedule. Opening the document does not move the view.

problem_ja: 「level 0」「tree state」は内部用語で、Haiku も指す範囲を取りにくかった。
suggested_en: The state of the head of the task group panel (level 0), above all top-level task groups. collapsed draws no task group at all. A new document starts with auto.

problem_ja: 「drawn on its day」が何をどこに描くのか不明で、Haiku も同じ文をなぞっただけ。仕様に描く場所の定めも見つからない。
suggested_en: MS Project's StartDate: the start of the project.

problem_ja: 「時刻は線を動かさない」は誤り。仕様（基準日線の要求）は、時刻を表示しているとき線を statusDate の瞬間の位置に引くとする。Haiku は誤りをそのまま写した。
suggested_en: MS Project's StatusDate: the date that progress is reported as of; the status line is drawn here. Absent means no status date: no status line is drawn and Delay Diagnostics does not run.

problem_ja: 「wall clock」「standard-time key」が硬く、Haiku も語を指摘した。
suggested_en: The fixed UTC offset that the schedule date-times are given in, written as a standard-time key such as UTC+09:00. Daylight saving is never applied. It is not written to MS Project.

problem_ja: 63語で長く、例外日の細目まで入っている。
suggested_en: The length of 1d in durations and lags, in minutes (480 when absent). Keep it equal to the working minutes of every working day. When a day differs, GRS reports it each time the document opens.

problem_ja: 設定行の ID（S-108）が入っている。スキーマだけを持つ読み手は引けない。
suggested_en: MS Project's numbering: 0 Sunday ... 6 Saturday (one less than WeekDay.dayType). Absent means Monday (1).

problem_ja: プロジェクトに属し documentSettings には無い理由は、設計の理由で中身ではない。
suggested_en: The hue of the theme, in degrees. Every color written as {"kind":"theme"} uses it. A new document starts with 214.

problem_ja: 「プロジェクトに属し、読み手に属さない」は設計の理由で中身ではない。
suggested_en: How many working days the progress point of a parent task may lie outside the progress points of the work below it, before Delay Diagnostics asks whether an update is missing. A new document starts with 1.

problem_ja: 「up to 2147483647」は範囲の言い直し。
suggested_en: One counter for the uids of tasks, resources, assignments and calendars. Uids are never reused, so a new uid is always above this value.

problem_ja: 何を持つかを言わず、省いたときの意味だけ書いている（Haiku は型名から補った）。
suggested_en: The working spans of this day of the week. Absent on a working day means the default spans 08:00-12:00, 13:00-17:00.

problem_ja: 何を持つかを先に言わず、3文50語。
suggested_en: MS Project's FromDate. For a one-off exception (see recurrenceKind), fromDate..toDate is the range of real days, written 00:00:00 to 23:59:00. For a recurring exception, fromDate is the start of the recurrence, not a real day.

problem_ja: 81語・5文で長い。例外の判定条件を詰めると読みやすい（Haiku も追いにくいと指摘）。
suggested_en: MS Project's Exception/Type: 1 daily, 2 yearly by date, 3 yearly by position, 4 monthly by date, 5 monthly by position, 6 weekly, 7 by day count, 8 by weekday count, 9 none. 9, absent, or 1 with recurrencePeriod absent or 1 means a one-off exception; any other row repeats and is not counted as days off. Write 1 for an exception you add.

problem_ja: 何を持つかを言わず、省いたときの意味だけ書いている。
suggested_en: The working spans of the exception days. Absent on a working day means the default spans 08:00-12:00, 13:00-17:00.

problem_ja: 何を持つかを言わず、00:00:00 の読み方から始まる。
suggested_en: MS Project's ToTime: the end of the working span. 00:00:00 means the end of the day (24:00), as MS Project writes it.

problem_ja: 「its actual given by dates」が不自然で、Haiku も指摘した。
suggested_en: One task: its plan, and its actual progress, both given by dates.

problem_ja: 何を持つかを言わず、持つ理由から始まる。
suggested_en: MS Project's CalendarUID for the task. It is kept only so that it goes back to MS Project unchanged; working days are counted with the one calendar that project.calendarUid names.

problem_ja: 「The fact」が何を指すか不明（Haiku も指摘）。何を持つかを先に言っていない。
suggested_en: MS Project's Milestone: whether the task is a milestone. Absent means false. When true, TaskVisual holds milestoneShape; otherwise it holds taskShape.

problem_ja: 名を MS Project のまま残す理由は設計の理由。
suggested_en: MS Project's Stop: how far the actual work has reached while the task is unfinished. Absent once actualFinish is set.

problem_ja: 105語・7文で、Haiku も式と数え方を追えなかった。
suggested_en: Follows from the dates: round(actual length / planned length x 100), in working minutes of the document calendar. The actual length runs from actualStart to actualFinish, or to stop while unfinished; a milestone is 100 once actualFinish is set, otherwise 0. GRS counts it again from the dates whenever it reads a GRS JSON file, so write what the dates give; it can be above 100.

problem_ja: 58語。「事実なので MS Project へ出し TaskVisual に入れない」は設計の理由。
suggested_en: Calendar days at the start of the bar, inside start..finish, drawn slanted to show that the start is not yet firm. Absent means no fade (a chevron keeps its normal notch); 0 means a flat end.

problem_ja: Task.calendarUid を参照するだけで、何を持つかを自分では言っていない（Haiku も指摘）。
suggested_en: MS Project's CalendarUID for the resource. It is kept only so that it goes back to MS Project unchanged; working days are counted with project.calendarUid.

problem_ja: タスクグループを WBS と分ける理由（複数タスクが1つを共有するため）は設計の理由。
suggested_en: A task group: one row of the task group panel and one band on the chart. Task groups form their own tree, separate from the WBS (Task.parentTaskUid), and are not exported to MS Project.

problem_ja: 「stands for」と末尾の「名の出どころではない」が分かりにくく、Haiku は言葉をなぞっただけ。
suggested_en: The task that this task group represents in the WBS. Absent means it represents no task. It does not decide the name of the task group.

problem_ja: 基準例そのもの: 保存する理由は中身ではない。5つの値のうち auto の意味と temporarilyExpanded が分からない（Haiku も3つしか言えなかった）。
suggested_en: Whether the task group is open, closed or hidden in the task group panel. auto follows documentSettings.taskGroupAutoExpandDepth; temporarilyExpanded is open until the view is shrunk or fitted.

problem_ja: 仕様では、editGroup が付いたタスクグループのタスクは GRS が編集を断る（読み取り専用）。この効果を書いていない。Haiku は「権限の単位か」と推測した。
suggested_en: The name of the group that may edit this task group. When it is set, GRS refuses edits to the tasks in this task group. Absent means anyone may edit.

problem_ja: 「(MS Project's name)」が何を指すか不明。Haiku も指摘した。
suggested_en: The URL the task group links to. Absent means no link.

problem_ja: 「lane」が未説明。D011 などの「drawn in」と違い「sits on」と言っている。
suggested_en: Which task group a task is drawn in; every task is in exactly one task group. GRS stacks the tasks of a task group itself, in the direction that documentSettings.stackDirection gives.

problem_ja: 「so that no other way ... is needed」は設計の理由。
suggested_en: How a task is drawn: its shape, its colors and its outline width. Every task has exactly one.

problem_ja: 最初の文が enum の値の言い直し。
suggested_en: Shape of a task that is not a milestone. Present exactly when Task.milestone is not true; a milestone holds milestoneShape instead.

problem_ja: 48語・5文で、HSL の式が専門的（Haiku も指摘）。
suggested_en: The fill color of the plan bar. Absent means no fill is drawn; fill and stroke may not both be absent. A custom color may give only one of light and dark: GRS works out the other when it loads the file.

problem_ja: 「Same shape as fillColor」は型の言い直し。
suggested_en: Outline color of the plan and actual bars. Absent means no outline is drawn.

problem_ja: 「1 to 10」は範囲の言い直し。
suggested_en: Outline width of the task's plan and actual bars, in CSS pixels at displayScalePercent 100. GRS writes 1 for a new task.

problem_ja: 3文・約55語で、oneOf の構造の語りが D234/D235 と重なる。
suggested_en: Where the leader line of the comment box points: a free point on the chart, or a point of a task or highlight box that the line is snapped to. A snapped anchor also keeps a fallback place, used when its target is deleted.

problem_ja: 「箱が指す先のそばに留まる」は設計理由で、持つ値の説明ではない。
suggested_en: Offset from the anchor point to the lower-left corner of the comment box body, in CSS pixels at displayScalePercent 100. It is scaled with displayScalePercent but not with zoom.

problem_ja: 範囲 (1 to 10) はスキーマが言うので重複。基準の言い方も二重で読みにくい。
suggested_en: Width of the comment box border and leader line, in CSS pixels at displayScalePercent 100. It is scaled with displayScalePercent but not with zoom. GRS writes 1 when it places a box.

problem_ja: 範囲 (8 to 24) の再掲と、倍率の二重の説明で長い。
suggested_en: Size of the comment box text, in CSS pixels at displayScalePercent 100. It is scaled with displayScalePercent but not with zoom. GRS writes 10 when it places a box.

problem_ja: 「(MS Project's name)」は名前の由来の注記で、Haiku も何の意味か迷った。
suggested_en: The URL that the comment box links to. Absent means no link.

problem_ja: 「schedule data clock」は内部語で、Haiku は何を指すか分からなかった。
suggested_en: The first day that the box covers (included), as a day in the schedule data time zone (project.scheduleDataTimeZone).

problem_ja: 範囲 (0 to 24) と「0 is a square corner」の再掲、倍率の二重説明。
suggested_en: Corner radius of the highlight box, in CSS pixels at displayScalePercent 100; 0 gives square corners. It is scaled with displayScalePercent but not with zoom. GRS writes 4 when it places a box.

problem_ja: 「枠は掴める」は画面操作の話で、データの意味ではなく、Haiku も描画と操作の区別で迷った。
suggested_en: Frame color of the highlight box. Absent means no frame line is drawn.

problem_ja: 範囲 (1 to 10) の再掲と倍率の二重説明。
suggested_en: Border width of the highlight box, in CSS pixels at displayScalePercent 100. It is scaled with displayScalePercent but not with zoom. GRS writes 1 when it places a box.

problem_ja: 「時計が動かないように外に置く」は設計理由で、「group's clock」も内部語。
suggested_en: When the document last changed and was saved, and who wrote it last.

problem_ja: 「A watcher of changes」が何か分からない (Haiku も迷った)。
suggested_en: When the schedule data last changed. watchChanges looks only at this time.

problem_ja: 6文・約75語。置き場所の理由、UTC の理由、MS Project の LastSaved の経緯は設計の話。
suggested_en: When the document was last written to its file, in UTC. Absent until it has been written once.

problem_ja: 2文だが長く、内部キー xmlns / #StopCountedFrom の中身は利用者に不要で、Haiku も意味を取れなかった。
suggested_en: Values of an imported MS Project element that GRS does not use, kept under their own names and written back unchanged. Only the MS Project export reads them.

problem_ja: 「which clock」は内部語。
suggested_en: A date without a time of day. Each property that uses it says which time zone the day is in.

problem_ja: 「standard-time key」の key が分かりにくい (Haiku も迷った)。
suggested_en: A fixed offset from UTC, written like UTC+09:00. Daylight saving time is never applied.

problem_ja: 「HSL lightness 1 - L」は色の専門語で、利用者に不要。
suggested_en: chosen: a person chose this value; derived: GRS made it from the other side when it loaded the document.

problem_ja: D250 と同じ「schedule data clock」。
suggested_en: The first day that is kept (included), as a day in the schedule data time zone (project.scheduleDataTimeZone).

problem_ja: text は ok。shape 欄に表番号 T-331/T-347/T-371 があるので shape 側で除く。
5文・約100語。set/clear の項目一覧はスキーマの再掲。
suggested_en: Edits the project of the document. `set` writes the listed properties and `clear` removes the listed optional ones; a property in both is refused (`fieldSetAndCleared`). Without `statusDate`, no status date line is drawn. Setting `scheduleDataTimeZone` does not convert the stored times: only the time zone they are read in changes.

problem_ja: 「列は仕様が決める」では利用者に何が動くか分からない (Haiku も指摘)。仕様を指す書き方になっている。
suggested_en: Moves every schedule date-time by `minutes`: positive is later, negative is earlier. It moves the planned and actual dates of tasks and baseline tasks, deadlines, and the project's `startDate` and `statusDate`; whole-day ranges and the calendar do not move. It is one write, and it is applied without asking the person when it comes from the Agent API.

problem_ja: 「どの列が動くか・動き方は仕様が決める」と仕様を指す。shape 欄には作業中の注記 (findings 09/12, assumes) も残っている。
suggested_en: Moves the whole schedule so that its earliest task start falls on `newStartDay` (YYYY-MM-DD). Every date moves by the same number of working days, so tasks keep their working-day lengths and gaps; the calendar does not move. A `newStartDay` that is a day off is moved back to the previous working day. It is one write, and it is applied without asking when it comes from the Agent API, as for `shiftScheduleTimes`.

problem_ja: 7文以上で長い。「default calendar なら先に calendar を作る」は誰が作るのか不明、「aligned by the side...」は意味が取れない (spec 側も曖昧)。
suggested_en: Edits the calendar: the working weekdays (`workingDayTypes`; 1 is Sunday, and weekdays not listed are days off), the day the week starts on (`weekStartDay`), the exception days (`exceptions`, the complete list after the edit) and one set of working times for a working day (`workingTimes`). A part you leave out stays as it is. `workingTimes` holds 1 to 5 time ranges; an empty list is refused. To go back to the default working times, pass the two ranges 08:00:00-12:00:00 and 13:00:00-17:00:00.

problem_ja: set/clear の項目一覧はスキーマの再掲で長い。「worked out again」の中身と passthroughValues が分からない。
suggested_en: Edits the task `taskUid`. `set` writes the listed properties and `clear` removes the listed optional ones; a property in both is refused (`fieldSetAndCleared`). The rules are checked on the task as it is after the edit, so you may send only one of `start` and `finish`; when either moves, GRS works out `percentComplete` again. A `hyperlinkAddress` that starts with `javascript:`, `vbscript:` or `data:` is refused (`hyperlinkSchemeNotAllowed`).

problem_ja: 6文・約140語。例は役に立つが長い。
suggested_en: Creates an unnamed task with the given `start` and `finish` on the task group `taskGroupId`. Give exactly one of `taskShape` (`rectangle`, `chevron`, `arrow` or `endpointSpan`) and `milestoneShape` (one of the 15 glyphs); `milestoneShape` makes the task a milestone. The new task's uid is `project.highestIssuedUid` plus 1, and `highestIssuedUid` moves to it, so later commands of the same batch can name the task (for example `editTask` with `taskUid` 42 when `highestIssuedUid` was 41). A `taskGroupId` that names no task group makes a new top-level task group with that id.

problem_ja: 「carried tasks」の意味が分からない (Haiku も指摘)。コピーが未着手で作られる事実も欠けている。
suggested_en: Duplicates the tasks listed in `sourceUids`. A child task that is not listed is not copied, and the copies start as not started. `landing` says where the copies are placed; it is sent only for a Ctrl-drag copy.

problem_ja: 「five plan-and-actual columns」の5つが何か分からない (Haiku も指摘)。
suggested_en: Puts the task `taskUid` into one plan-and-actual state. `place` holds the state and the actual dates that the state needs: `actualStart`, `stop`, `resume` and `actualFinish`.

problem_ja: 「grab handle」「dummy actual」は画面の語で、読む側は意味を取れない (Haiku も指摘)。
suggested_en: Starts the actual of the task `taskUid` after the person dragged its dummy actual (the placeholder mark of an actual that has not started). `grabbed` names the mark that was dragged, `released` is where it was let go, and `snapMinutes` is the snap step in minutes that sets the length of the actual.

problem_ja: `remembered` の説明が事実とずれる: 覚えた実績は suspended から not started へ戻すときに外され、後で not started から in progress へ進めるときに戻す。「state cycle」の順番も無い。
suggested_en: Moves the plan-and-actual state of the task `taskUid` one step along the cycle: not started, in progress, finished, suspended, and back to not started. A milestone alternates between not started and finished. `remembered` is the actual that an earlier step removed; pass it when the task goes from not started to in progress so that it is restored, and omit it when none is remembered. `snapMinutes` is the snap step in minutes; when omitted, the day step is used.

problem_ja: 「link type」が何か書かれていない (Haiku も指摘)。
suggested_en: Draws a dependency line from the task `predecessorUid` to the task `successorUid`. `predecessorEdge` and `successorEdge` name the ends (`start` or `finish`); the pair of ends decides the link type, for example finish-to-start. If either task is a milestone, the line is always finish-to-start, whatever the edges say.

problem_ja: Haiku は typed を「単位を指定する型」と誤読した。実際は minutes が長さで、unit は表示の単位だけ。shape 欄の注記「assumed」も作業中の言葉。
suggested_en: Changes the lag of the dependency from `predecessorUid` to `successorUid`; every line in that direction gets the new lag. `lag` is either a count of working days, or a length in minutes together with the unit (`day`, `hour` or `minute`) in which the lag is shown.

problem_ja: 6文で、set/clear の項目一覧はスキーマの再掲。
suggested_en: Edits the task group `taskGroupId`. `set` writes the listed properties and `clear` removes the listed optional ones; a property in both is refused (`fieldSetAndCleared`). Without `color` no band color is painted, and `name` does not follow the name of the task that the group stands for. `editGroup` is not built yet, so setting or clearing it is refused (`notImplemented`). A `hyperlinkAddress` that starts with `javascript:`, `vbscript:` or `data:` is refused (`hyperlinkSchemeNotAllowed`).

problem_ja: 6文で、set/clear の項目一覧はスキーマの再掲。
suggested_en: Edits how the task `taskUid` is drawn. `set` writes the listed properties and `clear` removes the listed optional ones; a property in both is refused (`fieldSetAndCleared`). `taskShape` is only for a task that is not a milestone and `milestoneShape` only for a milestone; the wrong one is refused (`milestoneShapeMismatch`). A color that is absent is not drawn, and a task left with neither `fillColor` nor `strokeColor` is refused (`fillAndStrokeBothInvisible`). To follow the theme again, set the color to {"kind":"theme"}.

problem_ja: 6文で、set/clear の項目一覧はスキーマの再掲。
suggested_en: Edits the comment box `commentBoxId`. `set` writes the listed properties and `clear` removes the listed optional ones; a property in both is refused (`fieldSetAndCleared`). The frame, the text and the fill always have a color, so `clear` cannot remove them; to hide the fill, set `fillTransparencyPercent` to 100. `anchor` has the same shape as in `createCommentBox`. A `hyperlinkAddress` that starts with `javascript:`, `vbscript:` or `data:` is refused (`hyperlinkSchemeNotAllowed`).

problem_ja: anchor の三つの形はスキーマ/shape の再掲。置くときの既定値 (何が書かれるか) が欠けている。
suggested_en: Places a comment box with the id `commentBoxId`, attached as `anchor` says. `anchor` is a free point, a task or a highlight box, and every property of the chosen kind is required. GRS gives the other properties their default values, and the new box has no text.

problem_ja: 6文で、set/clear の項目一覧はスキーマの再掲。「inverted」の説明も弱い。
suggested_en: Edits the highlight box `highlightBoxId`. `set` writes the listed properties and `clear` removes the listed optional ones; a property in both is refused (`fieldSetAndCleared`). Without `strokeColor` no frame line is drawn. A box whose last day comes before its first day, or whose bottom task group comes before its top task group, is refused (`highlightBoxInverted`); so is a box with no `strokeColor` and `fillTransparencyPercent` 100 (`fillAndStrokeBothInvisible`).

problem_ja: 5文で長く、set/clear の項目一覧はスキーマの再掲。「fixing」は isFixed のことだが分かりにくい (Haiku も指摘)。
suggested_en: Edits the document settings, which say how the schedule is shown. `set` writes the listed properties and `clear` removes the listed optional ones; a property in both is refused (`fieldSetAndCleared`). Pins and table views have their own commands (`pinTaskGroup`, `unpinTaskGroup` and `editTableView`). `fitSpan` is written whole, with `firstDay`, `lastDay` and `isFixed`; clearing it clears `isFixed` too. Setting `viewTimeZone` converts only the shown times; the stored values stay the same.

problem_ja: ボタン名が「Fit button」だが、画面の語は「Zoom to Fit」 (R090 は Zoom to Fit)。
suggested_en:
Fits the whole schedule to the screen of the page, as the Zoom to Fit button does: the page computes the zoom and the scroll position from its own screen size, so you need not know it.
The page computes them from the screen as drawn before this batch, so send it in a batch of its own after the edits that change the rows.
It does not unfold the task groups as the Zoom to Fit button also does; to unfold them, send resetTaskGroupTreeStates in an earlier batch.
It is refused while the page has not drawn its screen yet.

problem_ja: 5文・約100語で、set/clear の項目一覧はスキーマの再掲。
suggested_en: Edits how one table looks; `table` names it (`searchPanel`, `delayDiagnosticsReport` or `resourceList`). `set` writes the listed properties and `clear` removes the listed optional ones; a property in both is refused (`fieldSetAndCleared`). Only the properties that the named table has are accepted; any other is refused (`malformedRequest`). Clearing `sort` returns the table to its default order, and clearing a list means it has no items.

problem_ja: 「row ids」は仕様の内部語で、スキーマだけを持つ読み手には意味がない。
suggested_en: A short explanation in English for a person.
